content:
“The battlefield is your happy place!”

**Ground Pounder** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Small guns now reload faster and have better hip fire accuracy.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your small guns reload 30% faster and have 30% more hip fire accuracy. | 00006FAC | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your small guns reload 20% faster and have 20% more hip fire accuracy. | 00006FAB | 
| ★ | 1 | Your small guns reload 10% faster and have 10% more hip fire accuracy. | 00006F9B | 

- Update 62, reduced hip fire accuracy bonus from 15%/30%/45% to 10%/20%/30%.
- Before Update 60, Ground Pounder only worked with rifles and did not specify the exact hip fire bonus values.
- Until patch 1.7.5.4, the description stated it only applied to automatic rifles, though it still worked with semi-auto rifles.

Although the perk card art for Ground Pounder depicts a R91 assault rifle, this weapon is not available in the game.

Other reload speed perks include:

- Guerrilla Expert - scales with Onslaught stacks
- Gun Tricks - reload speed bonus for ghoul characters
- Lock and Load - reload speed bonus per stack
- Quick Hands - chance to instantly reload magazine
- Wild West Hands - chance to instantly reload magazine for ghoul characters
